issue.description:
Implement secret-aware sync reconcile behavior under research/specs/secret-write-boundary-v1.md section 4. Keep explicit local reconciliation available while preventing a newly discovered blocking finding from becoming Git-trackable.

Acceptance criteria:
- Reconcile scans resulting semantic state and retained generations; a new blocking finding commits the local reconciliation and durable quarantine atomically while withholding checkpoint publication.
- A failed reconcile leaves neither partial local reconciliation nor quarantine state; a clean reconcile retains existing publication behavior.
- Synthetic redacted tests assert exact local-versus-published state and that findings never appear in diagnostics or test output.
issue.notes: Added synthetic redacted reconcile regressions. Reconcile scans resulting live state and both retained generations inside the merge transaction; quarantine insert failure rolls back all local table state, and quarantined success leaves every checkpoint artifact byte-identical. Tests verify a finding in the previous-only generation and ensure CLI and doctor streams omit matched bytes. The transaction and publication hook already enforced these semantics; this commit pins the missing retained-only and rollback coverage. Commit 911bd6ef. issue.title: Quarantine Reconcile Results Before Publication

issue.description:
ADR-005 records as a drawback that there is no way to mark an assignment as deliberately parked, so a legitimate reservation triggers the same doctor warning as residue left by a worker that moved on — the documented path to the warning being ignored. Add a way to flag an open issue's assignment as intentionally held (settable through the public CLI, checkpointed, unknown-field-safe), and have the advisory ready_frontier check under doctor's `dependencies` scope exclude flagged issues from its warning sample and its named-id remedy output. Advisory only: doctor never clears an assignee, flagged or not, matching ADR-005's diagnose-don't-mutate stance.
